meta.title: Stories in Wilberforce
meta.summary: Art, objects, and documents tell Black histories at Wilberforce’s National Afro-American Museum & Cultural Center. Begin with what draws your eye.

sourceRefs.label: Ohio History Connection · National Afro-American Museum & Cultural Center

blocks.text: In Wilberforce, the National Afro-American Museum & Cultural Center collects and shares African American history and culture. I’d choose one object that catches your eye and ask whose life it touches; that question can open a thoughtful path through collections spanning art, civil rights, childhood, military history, inventions, and the records of Black organizations.

The museum also offers programs, and its archive is available by appointment. Check the current exhibitions, hours, admission, and archive arrangements before visiting. Wilberforce is home to Wilberforce University and Central State University, so this museum belongs to a wider landscape of Black education and community. Let the stories unfold.
